findings.title: Migration 0917 silently becomes a no-op on already-deployed environments
findings.body: The body of convert_org_saved_searches_to_views is replaced with an unconditional return. Migration 0917 is a historical migration that may already have been applied in some environments (the test file tests/sentry/migrations/test_0917... that exercised it was removed). For those databases the data conversion they previously ran is not reverted, while fresh installs skip it entirely. Replacing a shipped migration body rather than adding a new one breaks the invariant that applied migrations are immutable, and the comment refers to a 0921 file that does not appear in this PR.

findings.title: Org saved searches are never converted to views
findings.body: The revised migration 0920 is also stubbed out to return immediately, so organization-visible saved searches will not be migrated into GroupSearchView. The comment points to a 0921 migration that is not included in this change, so the conversion is dropped entirely and users lose their shared saved searches.

findings.title: Removed traceparent experiment option still referenced elsewhere
findings.body: The options/defaults.py change deletes the 'grouping.experiments.parameterization.traceparent' option, but this PR does not show removal of its consumers. Any code that still calls options.get on this key will raise an unregistered-option error at runtime; the change should be verified against all call sites.

findings.title: Broad exception swallowing and logging of exception object in get_environment_info
findings.body: get_environment_info catches every Exception and logs it under 'error' in extra with the raw exception object. Failures are silently reduced to an info-level log, and passing a non-serializable exception object in extra can break log formatting. Errors such as DB failures are hidden from Sentry and monitoring.

findings.title: Template is called via PRCommentWorkflow but defined on CommitContextIntegration; environment appended to title with no escaping
findings.body: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title, but the method is defined in the same class hierarchy used differently; more importantly the issue title and environment name are interpolated into Markdown without escaping, so titles containing Markdown or link syntax can break or inject content into the PR comment.

findings.title: Error events are fetched with zip against nodestore results that may be misaligned
findings.body: fetch_error_details zips error_ids with events.values(). nodestore get_multi returns a dict keyed by node id, and its values() order is not guaranteed to match error_ids, so error titles/messages can be attached to the wrong event IDs. Use the mapping by node_id instead.

findings.title: Timestamp default uses float 0.0 for error events while comparison also treats missing timestamp as 0
findings.body: In fetch_error_details the event dict is accessed with data.get on a possibly None-less value, and the error-message generator compares error timestamps against event.get('timestamp', 0), which is in seconds for the breadcrumbs but may be in a different unit for nodestore error payloads, leading to incorrect chronological interleaving.

findings.title: Logged event_data changed to workflow_event_data, dropping the consistent event payload
findings.body: The log extra key 'event_data' now receives workflow_event_data (which includes workflow_env) rather than the shared event_data object, changing the structured log schema that downstream dashboards may rely on without any note.

findings.title: Owner not validated against organization membership in create path
findings.body: The new owner field is accepted and stored directly in create(). Owner validation (organization membership) relies on ActorField, but the detector is created with owner_user_id/owner_team_id without checking that the team/user belongs to the detector's project/organization, allowing cross-organization ownership assignment through the API.

findings.title: Column fallback uses tableData optional chaining after dereferencing
findings.body: columnOrder computes Object.keys(tableData?.meta.fields) with optional chaining on tableData but then accesses tableData?.meta.fields[key] per key; if tableData is undefined, Object.keys(undefined) throws before the optional chain protects it, so the component crashes instead of rendering an empty table.

findings.title: Feature flag branch renders an empty table instead of the real data
findings.body: When the 'use-table-widget-visualization' feature is enabled, the TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with columns=[] and empty tableData, discarding result.data, result.meta, and loading state. Dashboard table widgets for that org will show no data at all.

findings.title: Attribute keys query lost its environment parameter and error/retry behavior
findings.body: The rewritten hook drops the staleTime, refetchOnWindowFocus and retry options and switches to useQuery with a queryKey that does not include all dependencies such as the selected environments previously sent in the request. Stale attribute lists can be served across environment/project changes.

findings.title: Hook no longer accepts enabled flag but callers still pass it
findings.body: Callers such as transactionNameSearchBar previously passed attributeKey and enabled; the rename removed those props from the type, so the removed options silently stop controlling fetch behavior and the attributeKey is now ignored in the query key.

findings.title: Visualize.fromJSON return type change breaks URL-state consumers
findings.body: fromJSON now returns Visualize[] instead of Visualize while the persisted JSON still uses yAxes arrays; any caller that expects a single Visualize (or the isVisualize check that now tests yAxis) can mis-parse existing saved queries and URLs containing multi-yAxis visualizes.

findings.title: Empty case leaves a dangling blank statement
findings.body: After removing the Type rows, the COMPONENT case is left with a blank line where data was pushed, and the removed Type row also removes information users relied on in grouping debugging, with no replacement.

findings.title: Serializer validation rejects reports with the same timestamp-age ambiguity and logs raw report bodies
findings.body: On validation failure the endpoint logs raw_report and the full validation_errors at warning level, which can contain arbitrary browser-supplied body data, inflating logs and potentially leaking user URLs. The endpoint also now returns 422 for any single malformed report, dropping the whole batch that was previously processed.

findings.title: Logger replaced with log_context logger without a corresponding import check
findings.body: logger switches to log_context.get_logger, which changes the logging namespace from the module logger; logs previously filtered by module name will no longer match.
